summary_md: **Yi Shi ([@_yishi_](https://x.com/_yishi_/status/2116054893400350734))** released **harnmem** for OpenCode: hot memories inject at session start through five in-process native tools with byte-stable injection to keep prompt caches hitting, one local Markdown store shared across pi, DSH, Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode; limits include Windows-only verification on 2.1.4 and mechanical extraction, with retrieval evals reporting Recall@10 1.0 and MRR 0.891 ([ys118/harnmem](https://github.com/ys118/harnmem), [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-harnmem)).
